title: Biotinylation by antibody recognition
protocol: Fix sample with 4% formaldehyde in PBST for 10 minutes at RT.
Wash twice with PBST.
Calculate cell number or protein concentration and mix equal amounts into a single tube.
Permeabilize for 7 minutes in PBS with 0.5% triton X-100.
Wash with PBST.
Add H2O2 to 0.5% for 10 minutes, wash twice with PBST.
Block with 1% BSA in PBST for 2 hours, shaking.
Stain with primary antibody overnight at 4°C.
Wash samples over 1 hour in PBST with at least 3 buffer changes.
Add Secondary HRP antibody at 1:1000 in 1% BSA for 1 hour.
Wash samples over 2 hours in PBST with at least 3 buffer changes.
Pre-incubate with 3ul TSA reagent for 5 minutes. Replace buffer with 150ul reaction buffer and incubate for 1-7m. Stop reaction with 1ml 500 mM sodium ascorbate.
Wash three times with PBST.
Add a red secondary fluorescent antibody, DAPI, and FITC-streptavidin to validate labeling by immunofluorescence of subsamples.
Incubate for 30 minutes at RT.
Wash samples over 1 hour in PBST with at least 3 buffer changes.
Mount subsamples on slides with vectashield.
Adjust volume to 0.1 ml PBST.
Add 30 μl of 10% SDS.
Add 20 μl of sodium deoxycholate 10% (optional).
Heat the mixture at 99°C for 1 hour with mild shaking.
Centrifuge at maximum speed for 5 minutes.
Adjust supernatant volume to 1 ml with PBST.
Add 250 μl of pre-washed streptavidin beads.
Incubate for 2 hours at room temperature.
Wash the beads once with PBST.
Wash the beads twice with PBST containing 1 M NaCl.
Wash the beads twice more with PBS.
Move beads to a new tube.
Reduce volume to 100 μl, subsamples (~10%) can be used for Western validations.
Precipitate unbound proteins by adding 6 volumes of cold acetone with 10 mM NaCl and placing in -20°C for 1 hour.
Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm for 15 minutes.
Resuspend beads/pellet in 90 μl 50 mM ABC (ammonium bicarbonate).
Add 2 μl of 500 mM DTT to the mixture and incubate for 30 minutes at 37°C with mixing, unbound for 30 minutes at 56°C.
Spike all samples with 10 μl of 550 mM Iodoacetamide and leave a further 20 minutes at room temperature in the dark.
Pellet beads and wash twice with 200 μl of 50 mM ABC.
Spike unbound with 20 μl of 100 mM DTT.
Resuspend beads in 200 μl of 50 mM ABC containing 2 μg of trypsin.
Incubate overnight at 37°C with mixing, add 2 μg of trypsin to unbound.
Add 1 µg of trypsin to each sample.
Incubate for an additional 2 hours at 37°C.
Pellet the beads at low speed and transfer the supernatant to a fresh tube.
Rinse the beads with 150 µl of HPLC-grade water and combine with the rest of the supernatant.
Spin the pooled eluant at 14,000 rpm for 2 minutes.
Transfer the supernatant to a fresh tube.
Reduce the sample volume in the vacuum centrifuge using Zip Tip.
Send the sample for mass spectrometry or store at -80°C.
